Clock: Show Time.script: (function(){const BANDS=["Early Morning", "Mid Morning", "Late Morning", "Early Afternoon", "Mid Afternoon", "Late Afternoon", "Early Evening", "Late Evening", "Night", "Late Night"];const WD=['Sunday','Monday','Tuesday','Wednesday','Thursday','Friday','Saturday'];const MO=[['March',31],['April',30],['May',31],['June',30],['July',31],['August',31],['September',30],['October',31],['November',30],['December',31],['January',31],['February',28]];function dateOf(d){let r=(Math.max(1,d)+29)%365,i=0;while(r>=MO[i][1]){r-=MO[i][1];i++;}return WD[(Math.max(1,d)-1)%7]+', '+MO[i][0]+' '+(r+1);}const tks=check({type:'game-tick'})||0;if(storage.skipTick===tks){skip=true;return;}const d=check({type:'read-number',key:'currentDay'})||1,b=check({type:'read-number',key:'currentBandIndex'})||0;effects.push({type:'story',instruction:'Current time: '+dateOf(d)+', '+BANDS[Math.max(0,Math.min(9,b))]+'. Weekdays hold classes and work; weekends are free time.'});})();
